title: Microsoft 365 admin center: agent-level controls for pay-as-you-go
summary: The briefing distinguishes the planned per-agent billing controls from the service-level billing controls documented today. Its licensing, metering, commands and roadmap facts are supported; minor corrections concern alternative agent navigation and checklist controls without matching table rows.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans agent-level controls for consumption-based agent use in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: This feature introduces admin controls for managing AI agents on a consumption basis within Microsoft 365 Copilot.

claims.claim: The planned controls let administrators specify which users can access particular agents through pay-as-you-go.
claims.quote: Administrators can specify which users can access particular agents through pay-as-you-go

claims.claim: Administrators are planned to control which agents are available for metered consumption.
claims.quote: control which agents are available for metered consumption

claims.claim: The roadmap plans billing policy for each agent.
claims.quote: and establish billing policy for each agent.

claims.claim: Initial scope is declarative agents in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and SharePoint.
claims.quote: Initially focusing on declarative agents in M365 Copilot Chat and SharePoint

claims.quote: control which agents are available for metered consumption, and establish billing policy for each agent.

claims.claim: SharePoint agent charges appear under the Copilot Studio meter on the invoice.

claims.quote: If you have a standalone Copilot credit policy (not paired with a pay-as-you-go billing policy), when your prepaid credits are exhausted, Copilot Chat is unavailable for users covered by the policy until credits replenish at the start of the next monthly billing period.

claims.claim: The standalone policy's prepaid credits replenish at the start of the next monthly billing period.
claims.quote: Copilot Chat is unavailable for users covered by the policy until credits replenish at the start of the next monthly billing period.
